title: Titanium Ultrasonic Horn 20kHz
alloyReason: Triaxially forged Titanium Ultrasonic Horn 20kHz (UNS R56400) is specified for this ultrasonic tooling component where isotropic mechanical properties are mandatory for withstanding multi-axial stress states. The 3D forging process eliminates crystallographic texture directionality, delivering uniform 950 MPa tensile strength and >15% elongation in all three orientations. This is critical for 20kHz cylindrical ultrasonic welding horn (sonotrode) where fatigue crack initiation is sensitive to microstructural anisotropy. This rationale is driven by 20khz cylindrical ultrasonic welding horn (sonotrode) and fat life requirements.
process: CNC turn-mill multi-axis for ultrasonic tooling geometry

surfaceTreatment: DLC coating 2um, 15GPa hardness, 0.1mu friction coefficient applied to wear surfaces for extended durability — tailored for 20khz cylindrical ultrasonic application
commonFailures: Corrosion pitting in road salt exposure - mitigated by DLC 2um 15GPa + hot wax sealant — critical for 20khz cylindrical ultrasonic performance

faq.q: What weight-to-strength ratio does Titanium Ultrasonic Horn 20kHz offer over steel?
faq.a: Grade 5 Ti-6Al-4V provides 40-45% weight reduction versus 4130/4340 steel at equivalent strength: 4.43 g/cm³ vs 7.85 g/cm³ with 830 MPa yield. For 20khz cylindrical ultrasonic, this translates directly to reduced unsprung mass (suspension) or reduced reciprocating mass (valvetrain), improving both acceleration response and fatigue-limited component life by 2-3×.

faq.a: Standard lead time for Titanium Ultrasonic Horn 20kHz is 15-25 business days depending on quantity and complexity. Rush orders (3-5 working days) are available for prototype evaluation. Sample evaluation (1-5 units) can be expedited to 5-7 business days. Volume pricing is available for production quantities above 100 units.

faq.q: What material certifications are provided with Titanium Ultrasonic Horn 20kHz?
faq.a: Each Titanium Ultrasonic Horn 20kHz shipment includes EN 10204 Type 3.1 mill test certificate with chemical analysis, mechanical properties, and heat identification. Dimensional inspection reports and Certificate of Conformance (CoC) are standard. First Article Inspection Reports (FAIR) per AS9102 are available on request for 20khz cylindrical ultrasonic.
